maintenance_request.title: Maintenance Request & Consultation Draft
maintenance_request.description: A booking, consultation draft attempt, or technical service request submitted or managed in the Kraken maintenance hub.

id.description: Unique identifier of the maintenance request or draft.

client.description: The name of the client organization or individual requesting maintenance or entering consultation.

service.description: The type of service requested (e.g., Deep Cleaning, HVAC Maintenance).

date.description: The targeted or scheduled date for the service.

status.description: The operational state of the service request or consultation draft.

priority.description: The level of urgency of the request.

amount.description: The financial cost associated with the service request.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns or created this request or draft.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

job_application.title: Job Application & CV Submission
job_application.description: Candidate application submitted on the Careers (Mi Carrera) page with candidate profile details and CV file.

id.description: Unique identifier of the job application.

name.description: Full name of the candidate applicant.

phone.description: Phone number or WhatsApp contact of the applicant.

cvName.description: Original file name of uploaded CV.

cvData.description: Base64 encoded data string or download link for the CV document.

cvType.description: MIME type of uploaded CV file.

userId.description: UID of candidate user or anonymous session.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when application was last updated.

maintenance_requests/{requestId}.description: A collection containing all maintenance and service request logs and consultation drafts.

job_applications/{applicationId}.description: A collection containing job candidate applications and CV submissions from the Careers page.
